texts.zh:
我们已开始着手庞大的科学枢纽的建设。基座已就位，主轴已准备。对突破性科技的允诺以及对大胆设想的超越都将等待着我们。路漫漫其修远兮，吾将上下而求索。

宇宙无尽的谜团最终都能被我们所掌控吗？
texts.en:
We have now begun the massive undertaking of constructing a Science Nexus. The foundation is in place and preparations are underway to add the main hub. The promise of new groundbreaking technologies and the realization of ideas beyond our wildest imaginations await. And though the road ahead is long and full of challenges, we have taken the first step.

Could the endless mysteries of the universe finally be within our grasp?

label.en: The future is ours.
After the next upgrade: Hub built (think_tank_1)

notes.zh: 审阅说明：科学枢纽每完成一个建造阶段，由 on_megastructure_built / on_megastructure_upgraded 在建造国触发对应事件（并非选项链接）；各阶段按建造顺序排列。
notes.en: Review note: each build stage of the Science Nexus fires its own event for the builder from on_megastructure_built / on_megastructure_upgraded (not option links); stages are shown in construction order.

texts.zh: 科学枢纽的中央核心已就位，这个核心安装了一个最新工艺水平的奇点反应堆。我们的工程师准备加装下一个，也是最有挑战的设施片段——四个研究辅翼，足够承载极端炎热，极端的压力波动，以及外星病原体。辅翼也能为研究者提供很多住房。
texts.en: The Science Nexus central hub is now in place, equipped with a state of the art singularity reactor. Our engineers are preparing to add the next, most challenging segment of the facility - the four research wings. They will be fitted with pioneering technology - able to withstand everything from violent heat to intense pressure waves and alien pathogens. They will also provide housing for our many researchers.

label.en: We've come a long way.

label.zh: 升级后：研究侧翼第一阶段完成（think_tank_2）
label.en: After the next upgrade: Research wings first stage done (think_tank_2)

label.zh: 中心建成时：有通讯并有情报的玩家帝国收到通知（隐藏事件81）
label.en: When the hub is built: human empires with communications/intel get a notice (hidden 81)

texts.zh: 第一个模组——四个研发辅翼已就位，研究者与工作人员已前往他们的生活分区。下一步也是最后一部我们将延展辅翼，添加四个实验室区间以支持我们最危险的研究。我们已采取进一步的安保来保证工作人员的安全。
texts.en: The first module of the four research wings is now in place and researchers and staff are already moving into the living quarters. The next and final step of construction will extend the wings, adding four sections of laboratories equipped to support our most dangerous research. Extensive security measures are being taken to ensure the staff's safety.

label.en: We're almost there...
After the next upgrade: Science Nexus completed (think_tank_3)

texts.zh:
今天我们庆祝这个伟大的科学枢纽的开启。伴随着它那最尖端的科研设备与革新科技，我们可以毫无阻力地吸引全星系甚至整个宇宙最伟大的头脑，这正是我们希望的。这项功绩将成为一个新启蒙时代的开端。

今天会是我们物种历史中伟大的一天。
texts.en:
Today we celebrate the grand opening of the Science Nexus. With its state of the art research facilities and innovative technology we will have no trouble attracting the greatest minds from across the empire, or even the universe, should we so desire. This feat truly marks the beginning of a new era of enlightenment.

It is a big day in the history of our kind.

texts.zh: 今天我们庆祝着另一个科学枢纽的完成。如果我们之前的成就还不够的话，这一个科学枢纽的完成定能将我们置于宇宙科学进步的前沿。我们的科学进步让我们能自己定夺我们的未来。
texts.en: Today we celebrate the completion of yet another Science Nexus. If our previous accomplishments hadn't already, this will surely earn us a place on the forefront of scientific progress in the universe. Our technological advancements will allow us to shape the future to our liking.

label.en: Indeed.

label.zh: 完工时：同样条件的玩家帝国收到通知
label.en: On completion: the same empires get a notice

texts.zh: [From.GetName]完成了科学枢纽的建造。现在他们有能力反驳所有对他们有疑惑的人，并让他们处在科学进步的前沿。我们也许要注意他们，完成这样一个建筑未来必然会造福于他们的科技，让他们获得对我们的文明的优势。
texts.en: The [From.GetName] have constructed a Science Nexus, disproving all who doubted and placing them on the forefront for scientific progress. We may want to keep an eye on them, as the completion of such a structure will surely propel their technology into the future, giving them an advantage over other civilizations.

label.en: OK

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现那个帝国的名字。
note.en: In the game, the name of the other empire appears here.

texts.zh:
[From.GetName]开始挑战科学枢纽的建设——一座科技极其先进的科研设施，足以让科学进程产生革命性颠覆。

[think_tank_system.GetName]星系热火如荼，工程师们正在组装建筑初始平台。无论他们成功与否，单纯这次尝试就足以让他们成为我们这一时代的先行者。
texts.en:
The [From.GetName] have taken on the challenge of building a Science Nexus - a research institute, so technically advanced, that it could revolutionize the scientific process completely.

The [think_tank_system.GetName] system is bustling with activity as engineers are assembling the initial build site. Regardless of whether they fail or succeed, trying alone has earned them a place among the great forerunners of our time.

texts.zh: [From.GetName]开始着手建造另一个科学枢纽，这一次是在[think_tank_system.GetName]星系。
texts.en: The [From.GetName] have begun to construct yet another Science Nexus, this time in the [think_tank_system.GetName] system.

label.en: A testament to the ingenuity of intelligent life.

label.zh: 一如既往，他们如此超前。
label.en: As always, they're overreaching.

label.zh: 我们将粉碎[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，让其为之燃烧……
label.en: Crash and burn [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]...

note.en: In the game, the species' name appears here.

texts.zh: 我们在[nexus_system.GetName]发现了一座巨大太空装置的残骸。该巨型结构似乎曾是一个巨大的科学枢纽。尽管其已废弃数千年，但其主体结构依然完好。
texts.en: The broken remnants of a colossal space installation have been found near the [nexus_system.GetName]. This megastructure appears to have once served as some kind of massive Science Nexus. Although the installation has obviously been abandoned for millennia, its hull is still reasonably intact.

label.zh: 它看起来与我们的科学枢纽具有相近的功能。
label.en: The concept appears similar to our own Science Nexus.
Fascinating.

label.zh: 修复废墟（建造“修复”型巨型结构）后

texts.zh: 在[From.GetName]附近的废弃科学枢纽已被完全修复了，并配备了[Root.GetName]的精英科学家。这个巨型结构仍然保持着设计师当初建造它时的初衷，在这个时代继续帮助我们解决更多的科学问题。
texts.en: The abandoned Science Nexus near [From.GetName] has been fully repaired and staffed by the brightest minds of the [Root.GetName]. As was no doubt its original purpose, the megastructure will now be put to use in answering the scientific questions of our time.

label.en: Excellent.

summary.text:
# 科学枢纽 / Science Nexus

- 分类 Category：银河轶事 C8 stories · 来源 Sources：events/megastructure_events_1.txt、common/megastructures/03_think_tank.txt、common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt（on_megastructure_built / on_megastructure_upgraded / on_entering_system_first_time）· DLC：Utopia（按本地化文件名）· 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

在你自己的边境内放置并开工科学枢纽（见 common/megastructures/03_think_tank.txt）。每个建造阶段完工时，巨型结构的 on_build_complete 或 on_megastructure_upgraded 触发对应的国家事件；这些事件只是阶段提示，没有选择分支（每个只有一个“确认”选项）。
You place and start a Science Nexus inside your borders (common/megastructures/03_think_tank.txt). Every completed build stage fires a country event for the builder; these are stage notices with a single confirm option, no branching.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. utopia.80：科学枢纽基址建成（think_tank_0） / Science Nexus site built (think_tank_0)
2. utopia.83：枢纽中心建成（think_tank_1） / Hub built (think_tank_1)
3. utopia.85：研究侧翼第一阶段完成（think_tank_2） / Research wings first stage done (think_tank_2)
4. utopia.84：科学枢纽完工（think_tank_3） / Science Nexus completed (think_tank_3)

按顺序出现，由建造进度决定，不由事件编号决定。 They appear in construction order, driven by build progress rather than by event id.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 其他帝国的通知 Notices to other empires：
- utopia.82：中心建成时：有通讯并有情报的玩家帝国收到通知（隐藏事件81） / When the hub is built: human empires with communications/intel get a notice (hidden 81)
- utopia.86：完工时：同样条件的玩家帝国收到通知 / On completion: the same empires get a notice
- 废墟 The ruin：utopia.2012（星系首次进入时，需该星系的星标记“ruined_nexus_system”）可以选择“与我们的相近”（已拥有同类）或“很迷人”（没有同类时，30天后进入通用跟进事件 story.5）；utopia.2013 在修复完成后出现。
  utopia.2012 fires when a ship first enters the system; the option depends on whether you already own this megastructure ("fascinating" otherwise, which fires the generic follow-up story.5 after 30 days). utopia.2013 fires when the ruin is restored.
- 没有随机或互斥分支，只有“建造阶段”与“废墟/修复”两条独立线索。 No random or exclusive branches: two independent threads (build stages; ruin and restoration).

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 建造阶段事件仅发给建造国；通知事件发给满足通讯与情报条件的其他非AI国家。 Stage events go to the builder only; notices go to other non-AI countries that meet the communication/intel condition.


## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：common/megastructures/03_think_tank.txt 各阶段 on_build_complete，common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt 的 on_megastructure_* 与 on_entering_system_first_time 列表，events/megastructure_events_1.txt 中各事件的 trigger/option。
- 更正 Corrections：原先每个阶段、通知与废墟事件各自成为一个单页故事；现合并为同一巨型结构的故事，阶段按建造顺序连接。 Previously every stage, notice and ruin event was its own one-card story; they are merged and ordered by construction.
- 不确定 Uncertain：废墟如何被放置（星系初始化器/事件的星标记）未逐一追踪。 How ruins are placed on the map (system initializers / star flags) was not traced one by one.
